## LOAD PACKAGES

```{r, results='hide', message=FALSE}

library(tidyverse)
library(tibble)
library(readxl)
library(summarytools)
library(sjlabelled)
library(labelled)
library(qs)
library(tidycomm)

```

## LOAD DATASETS & SUBSET

```{r, results='hide', message=FALSE}

## Read in DNA methylation meta file 
Oct24_meta <- qread("Datasets/OCT_24meta.qs") 
## Select columns of interest
Oct24_meta <- select(Oct24_meta, 'HH_ID', 'PN', 'Sample_Name', 'Sample_Well', 'Sample_Plate', 'Basename', 'GR', 'NK', 'B', 'CD4', 'CD8', 'MO', 'exclude')
## Remove basename rows
row.names(Oct24_meta) <- NULL


## Read in Global Methylation file
globalM_OCT24 <- read_csv("Datasets/globalmethylationOCT24_summary.csv")
## Select columns of interest
globalM_OCT24 <- select(globalM_OCT24, 'Basename', 'globalmethylation', 'Island_mean', 'OpenSea_mean', 'Shelf_mean', 'Shore_mean')


## Read in covariate files 
load("Datasets/hrs_combine_wide.RData")
load("Datasets/randhrs1992_2018v1.rda")
## Select columns of interest
hrs_combine_wide <- select(hrs_combine_wide, 'HHIDPN', 'gender', 'race', 'hispanic', 'education', 'smoke2008', 'smoke2010', 'smoke2012', 'smoke2014', 'smoke2016')
rand92_2018V1 = randhrs1992_2018v1
rm(randhrs1992_2018v1)
rand92_2018V1 <- select(rand92_2018V1, 'HHID', 'PN', 'R13HIBPE', 'R12HIBPE', 'R11HIBPE', 'R10HIBPE', 'R9HIBPE', 'R13DIABE', 'R12DIABE', 'R11DIABE', 'R10DIABE', 'R9DIABE', 'H9ATOTB', 'H10ATOTB', 'H11ATOTB', 'H12ATOTB', 'H13ATOTB', 'R13MDACTX', 'R12MDACTX', 'R11MDACTX', 'R10MDACTX', 'R9MDACTX', 'R13LTACTX', 'R12LTACTX', 'R11LTACTX', 'R10LTACTX', 'R9LTACTX', 'R13VGACTX', 'R12VGACTX', 'R11VGACTX', 'R10VGACTX', 'R9VGACTX')


## Read in exposure and additional covariate file
  ## Internal merged file 
load("Datasets/hrs_democoggen_wide20200910.Rda")
  ## Sourced from: https://hrs.isr.umich.edu/sites/default/files/meta/xyear/childfamhealth/codebook/aggchldfh2016a_ri.htm
  ## Methodology: https://hrsdata.isr.umich.edu/sites/default/files/documentation/data-descriptions/ChildhoodHealthAndFamily.pdf
chf <- read_xlsx("Datasets/AGCHFH16.xlsx")
## Select columns of interest
hrs_democoggen_wide <- select(hrs0910, 'HHID', 'PN', 'childrural', 'SCHLYRS', 'BEALE2013_08', 'BEALE2013_10', 'BEALE2013_12', 'BEALE2013_14', 'Parent_Education')
rm(hrs0910)
chf <- select(chf, 'HHID', 'PN', 'LIVEGPAR', 'CHSMOKE')


## Read in outcome and additional covariate file
load("Datasets/full_labelled.RData")
## Select columns of interest
full.labelled <- select(full.labelled, 'HHID', 'PN', 'age', 'race.ethnicity', 'sex', 'BIRTHYR', 'HORVATH_DNAMAGE', 'HANNUM_DNAMAGE', 
'LEVINE_DNAMAGE', 'DNAMGRIMAGE', 'MPOA')

```

## DATA WRANGLING

```{r}

## Format participant ID columns for merging
  ## hrs_democoggen_wide (all leading zeros for HHID and PN)
hrs_democoggen_wide$HHID<- as.numeric(hrs_democoggen_wide$HHID)
hrs_democoggen_wide$HHIDPN <- paste0(hrs_democoggen_wide$HHID, hrs_democoggen_wide$PN)
hrs_democoggen_wide<- select(hrs_democoggen_wide, HHIDPN, everything())


  ## HRS_DNAm_meta (intermittent leading zero for HHID, 1 leading zero PN)
Oct24_meta$HH_ID<- as.numeric(Oct24_meta$HH_ID)
Oct24_meta$HHIDPN<- paste0(Oct24_meta$HH_ID, Oct24_meta$PN)
Oct24_meta<- select(Oct24_meta, HHIDPN, everything())


  ## Additional ELE data CHF dataset (intermittent leading zero for HHID, 1 leading zero PN)
chf$HHID <- as.numeric(chf$HHID)
chf$HHIDPN <- paste0(chf$HHID, chf$PN)
chf <- select(chf, HHIDPN, everything())


  ## Outcome data & additional covariates
full.labelled$HHID <- as.numeric(full.labelled$HHID)
full.labelled$HHIDPN<- paste0(full.labelled$HHID, full.labelled$PN)
full.labelled<- select(full.labelled, HHIDPN, everything())

rand92_2018V1$HHID <- as.numeric(rand92_2018V1$HHID)
rand92_2018V1$HHIDPN<- paste0(rand92_2018V1$HHID, rand92_2018V1$PN)
rand92_2018V1<- select(rand92_2018V1, HHIDPN, everything())


  ## Check class new HHIDPN variables
class(chf$HHIDPN)
class(full.labelled$HHIDPN)
class(rand92_2018V1$HHIDPN)
class(hrs_democoggen_wide$HHIDPN)
class(Oct24_meta$HHIDPN)
class(hrs_combine_wide$HHIDPN)
class(Oct24_meta$Basename)
class(globalM_OCT24$Basename)


  ## Convert hrs_combine_wide to character
hrs_combine_wide$HHIDPN<- as.character(hrs_combine_wide$HHIDPN)


## Merge cell composition df with HRS meta file 
Oct24_metaGM <- full_join(Oct24_meta, globalM_OCT24, by = "Basename")
dim(Oct24_metaGM)


## Merge above with hrs_combine_wide
HRS_DNAm_meta_Cell2 <- left_join(Oct24_metaGM, hrs_combine_wide, by = "HHIDPN")
dim(HRS_DNAm_meta_Cell2)
  ## Check merge
dfSummary(HRS_DNAm_meta_Cell2$smoke2008)


## Merge above with hrs_democoggen_wide 
HRS_DNAm_meta_Cell4 <- left_join(HRS_DNAm_meta_Cell2, hrs_democoggen_wide, by = "HHIDPN")
dim(HRS_DNAm_meta_Cell4)
  ## Check merge
dfSummary(HRS_DNAm_meta_Cell4$BEALE2013_10)
dfSummary(HRS_DNAm_meta_Cell4$smoke2008)
dfSummary(HRS_DNAm_meta_Cell4$race)
dfSummary(HRS_DNAm_meta_Cell4$Parent_Education)


## Merge above with chf 
HRS_DNAm_meta_Cell7 <- left_join(HRS_DNAm_meta_Cell4, chf, by ="HHIDPN")
dim(HRS_DNAm_meta_Cell7)
  ## Check merge
dfSummary(HRS_DNAm_meta_Cell7$race)
dfSummary(HRS_DNAm_meta_Cell7$hispanic)
dfSummary(HRS_DNAm_meta_Cell7$childrural) 
dfSummary(HRS_DNAm_meta_Cell7$SCHLYRS) 
dfSummary(HRS_DNAm_meta_Cell7$CHSMOKE) 
dfSummary(HRS_DNAm_meta_Cell7$LIVEGPAR) 


## Merge above with full.labelled
HRS_DNAm_meta_Cell8 <- left_join(HRS_DNAm_meta_Cell7, full.labelled, by ="HHIDPN")
dim(HRS_DNAm_meta_Cell8)


## Merge above with rand92_2018V1
HRS_DNAm_meta_Cell9 <- left_join(HRS_DNAm_meta_Cell8, rand92_2018V1, by ="HHIDPN")
dim(HRS_DNAm_meta_Cell9)

```

```{r}

saveRDS(Oct24_meta, file = "NewData/HRS_DNAm_meta_nk20261703.RDS")

saveRDS(hrs_combine_wide, file = "NewData/hrs_combine_wide_nk20261703.RDS")

saveRDS(hrs_democoggen_wide, file = "NewData/hrs_democoggen_wide_nk20261703.RDS")

saveRDS(globalM_OCT24, file = "NewData/global_methylation_nk20261703.RDS")

saveRDS(chf, file = "NewData/chf_nk20261703.RDS")

saveRDS(full.labelled, file = "NewData/full.labelled_nk20261703.RDS")

saveRDS(rand92_2018V1, file = "NewData/rand92_2018V1_nk20261703.RDS")

rm(chf, full.labelled, hrs_democoggen_wide, rand92_2018V1, globalM_OCT24, hrs_combine_wide, Oct24_meta, Oct24_metaGM, HRS_DNAm_meta_Cell2, HRS_DNAm_meta_Cell4, HRS_DNAm_meta_Cell7, HRS_DNAm_meta_Cell8)

```

## VARIABLE FACTOR AND RECODING

```{r}

  ## Create a collapsed race/ethnicity variable for regression models (combine NH-Other and Hispanic groups)
dfSummary(HRS_DNAm_meta_Cell9$race.ethnicity)
HRS_DNAm_meta_Cell9 <- HRS_DNAm_meta_Cell9 %>% mutate(raceethnicity_collapsed = case_when(
race.ethnicity == "NH-White"~ "NH-White",
race.ethnicity == "NH-Black"~ "NH-Black",
race.ethnicity == "NH-Other"~ "Other/Hispanic",
race.ethnicity == "Hispanic"~ "Other/Hispanic"))
HRS_DNAm_meta_Cell9$raceethnicity_collapsed <- ordered(HRS_DNAm_meta_Cell9$raceethnicity_collapsed, levels = c("NH-White", "NH-Black", "Other/Hispanic"))
dfSummary(HRS_DNAm_meta_Cell9$raceethnicity_collapsed)
HRS_DNAm_meta_Cell9$raceethnicity_collapsed = set_label(HRS_DNAm_meta_Cell9$raceethnicity_collapsed, label = ("Race/ethnicity"))


## Factor and recode Levels of grew up in a rural area (childrural_democoggen: 1 = YES, 5 = NO, 8 = NA)
HRS_DNAm_meta_Cell9$childrural_democoggen <- factor(HRS_DNAm_meta_Cell9$childrural, levels = c(1,5), labels = c("Yes", "No"))
table(HRS_DNAm_meta_Cell9$childrural, HRS_DNAm_meta_Cell9$childrural_democoggen)
dfSummary(HRS_DNAm_meta_Cell9$childrural)
dfSummary(HRS_DNAm_meta_Cell9$childrural_democoggen)


## Factor and Recode Levels of childhood smoking (CHSMOKE_R: 1 = YES, 5 = NO)
HRS_DNAm_meta_Cell9$CHSMOKE_R <- factor(HRS_DNAm_meta_Cell9$CHSMOKE, levels = c(1,5), labels =  c("Yes", "No"))
dfSummary(HRS_DNAm_meta_Cell9$CHSMOKE)
dfSummary(HRS_DNAm_meta_Cell9$CHSMOKE_R)


## Factor and Recode Levels of live with a grandparent (LIVEGPAR: 1 = YES, 5 = NO, 8 = NA)
HRS_DNAm_meta_Cell9$LIVEGPAR[HRS_DNAm_meta_Cell9$LIVEGPAR == "8"] <- NA
HRS_DNAm_meta_Cell9$LIVEGPAR_R <- factor(HRS_DNAm_meta_Cell9$LIVEGPAR, levels = c(1,5), labels = c("Yes", "No"))
dfSummary(HRS_DNAm_meta_Cell9$LIVEGPAR)
dfSummary(HRS_DNAm_meta_Cell9$LIVEGPAR_R)


## Recode/Factor: Covariates
## Life course behavior and socioeconomic variables: Uses responses from 2016 and if missing takes the next valid response 
  ## Smoking Status
HRS_DNAm_meta_Cell9 <- HRS_DNAm_meta_Cell9 %>% 
  mutate(smoke_latest = coalesce(smoke2016, smoke2014, smoke2012, smoke2010, smoke2008)
)
dfSummary(HRS_DNAm_meta_Cell9$smoke_latest)
HRS_DNAm_meta_Cell9$smoke_latest <- factor(HRS_DNAm_meta_Cell9$smoke_latest, levels = c(0, 1, 2), labels = c("Never", "Former", "Current"))
table(HRS_DNAm_meta_Cell9$smoke_latest)


  ## BEALE (Urban-Rural Status)
HRS_DNAm_meta_Cell9 <- HRS_DNAm_meta_Cell9 %>% 
  mutate(BEALE_latest = coalesce(BEALE2013_14, BEALE2013_12, BEALE2013_10, BEALE2013_08)
)
dfSummary(HRS_DNAm_meta_Cell9$BEALE_latest)
HRS_DNAm_meta_Cell9$BEALE_latest <- factor(HRS_DNAm_meta_Cell9$BEALE_latest, levels = c(1,2, 3), labels = c("Urban", "Suburban", "Ex-urban"))
table(HRS_DNAm_meta_Cell9$BEALE_latest)


  ## Total Household Assets
HRS_DNAm_meta_Cell9 <- HRS_DNAm_meta_Cell9 %>% 
  mutate(ATOTB_latest = coalesce(H13ATOTB, H12ATOTB, H11ATOTB, H10ATOTB, H9ATOTB)
)
dfSummary(HRS_DNAm_meta_Cell9$ATOTB_latest)


## Adult health variables: Uses responses from 2016 and if missing takes the next valid response 
  ## High Blood Pressure
HRS_DNAm_meta_Cell9 <- HRS_DNAm_meta_Cell9 %>% 
  mutate(HIBP_latest = coalesce(R13HIBPE, R12HIBPE, R11HIBPE, R10HIBPE, R9HIBPE)
)
dfSummary(HRS_DNAm_meta_Cell9$HIBP_latest)
HRS_DNAm_meta_Cell9$HIBP_latest <- factor(HRS_DNAm_meta_Cell9$HIBP_latest, levels = c(0,1), labels = c("No", "Yes"))
table(HRS_DNAm_meta_Cell9$HIBP_latest)


  ## Diabetes
HRS_DNAm_meta_Cell9 <- HRS_DNAm_meta_Cell9 %>% 
  mutate(DIAB_latest = coalesce(R13DIABE, R12DIABE, R11DIABE, R10DIABE, R9DIABE)
)
dfSummary(HRS_DNAm_meta_Cell9$DIAB_latest)
HRS_DNAm_meta_Cell9$DIAB_latest <- factor(HRS_DNAm_meta_Cell9$DIAB_latest, levels = c(0,1), labels = c("No", "Yes"))
table(HRS_DNAm_meta_Cell9$DIAB_latest)


  ## Vigorous Physical Activity
HRS_DNAm_meta_Cell9 <- HRS_DNAm_meta_Cell9 %>% 
  mutate(VIGACT_latest = coalesce(R13VGACTX, R12VGACTX, R11VGACTX, R10VGACTX, R9VGACTX)
)
dfSummary(HRS_DNAm_meta_Cell9$VIGACT_latest)


## Collapse variable categories
  ## Collapse VIGACT_latest to Never = 0, Every day/>1 per week = 1, 1 per week/1-3 per month = 2
  ## "Every Day", ">1 per week", "1 per week", "1-3 per month", "never"
  ## 1, 2, 3, 4, 5
table(HRS_DNAm_meta_Cell9$VIGACT_latest, useNA = "always")
HRS_DNAm_meta_Cell9 <- HRS_DNAm_meta_Cell9 %>% mutate(VIGACT_collapsed = case_when(
  VIGACT_latest == 5 ~ 0,
  VIGACT_latest == 1 ~ 1,
  VIGACT_latest == 2 ~ 1,
  VIGACT_latest == 3 ~ 2, 
  VIGACT_latest == 4 ~ 2))

table(HRS_DNAm_meta_Cell9$VIGACT_collapsed, useNA = "always")
HRS_DNAm_meta_Cell9$VIGACT_collapsed <- factor(HRS_DNAm_meta_Cell9$VIGACT_collapsed, 
                                       levels = c(0,1,2), 
                                       labels= c("Never",
                                                 "Every day/>1 per week",
                                                 "1 per week/1-3 per month"))

table(HRS_DNAm_meta_Cell9$VIGACT_collapsed, HRS_DNAm_meta_Cell9$VIGACT_latest) 


  ## Create SCHLYRS categorical
  ## Less than High School (SCHLYRS<12), High school and more (SCHLYRS>=12)
HRS_DNAm_meta_Cell9 <- HRS_DNAm_meta_Cell9 %>% mutate(SCHLYRS_cat = ifelse((SCHLYRS >= 12), 1, 0))

HRS_DNAm_meta_Cell9$SCHLYRS_cat <- factor(HRS_DNAm_meta_Cell9$SCHLYRS_cat, levels = c(0,1), labels=
                                   c("Less than 12 years", "12 or more years"))

table(HRS_DNAm_meta_Cell9$SCHLYRS_cat, useNA = "always")


  ## Create global methylation categorical (high vs low --> use a cutoff of ~59.34 based on variable median) 
summary(HRS_DNAm_meta_Cell9$globalmethylation)
HRS_DNAm_meta_Cell9 <- HRS_DNAm_meta_Cell9 %>% mutate(globalmethylation_cat = ifelse((globalmethylation > 59.34), 1, 0))
HRS_DNAm_meta_Cell9$globalmethylation_cat <- factor(HRS_DNAm_meta_Cell9$globalmethylation_cat, levels = c(0,1), labels = c("Low", "High"))
table(HRS_DNAm_meta_Cell9$globalmethylation_cat)


  ## Island (high vs low --> use a cutoff of ~18.09 based on variable mean) 
summary(HRS_DNAm_meta_Cell9$Island_mean)
HRS_DNAm_meta_Cell9 <- HRS_DNAm_meta_Cell9 %>% mutate(Island_mean_cat = ifelse((Island_mean > 18.09), 1, 0))
HRS_DNAm_meta_Cell9$Island_mean_cat <- factor(HRS_DNAm_meta_Cell9$Island_mean_cat, levels = c(0,1), labels = c("Low", "High"))
table(HRS_DNAm_meta_Cell9$Island_mean_cat)


  ## Open Sea (high vs low --> use a cutoff of ~76.90 based on variable mean) 
summary(HRS_DNAm_meta_Cell9$OpenSea_mean)
HRS_DNAm_meta_Cell9 <- HRS_DNAm_meta_Cell9 %>% mutate(OpenSea_mean_cat = ifelse((OpenSea_mean > 76.90), 1, 0))
HRS_DNAm_meta_Cell9$OpenSea_mean_cat <- factor(HRS_DNAm_meta_Cell9$OpenSea_mean_cat, levels = c(0,1), labels =  c("Low", "High"))
table(HRS_DNAm_meta_Cell9$OpenSea_mean_cat)


  ## Shelf (high vs low --> use a cutoff of ~78.66 based on variable mean) 
summary(HRS_DNAm_meta_Cell9$Shelf_mean)
HRS_DNAm_meta_Cell9 <- HRS_DNAm_meta_Cell9 %>% mutate(Shelf_mean_cat = ifelse((Shelf_mean > 78.66), 1, 0))
HRS_DNAm_meta_Cell9$Shelf_mean_cat <- factor(HRS_DNAm_meta_Cell9$Shelf_mean_cat, levels = c(0,1), labels = c("Low", "High"))
table(HRS_DNAm_meta_Cell9$Shelf_mean_cat)


  ## Shore (high vs low --> use a cutoff of ~48.92 based on variable mean) 
summary(HRS_DNAm_meta_Cell9$Shore_mean)
HRS_DNAm_meta_Cell9 <- HRS_DNAm_meta_Cell9 %>% mutate(Shore_mean_cat = ifelse((Shore_mean > 48.92), 1, 0))
HRS_DNAm_meta_Cell9$Shore_mean_cat <- factor(HRS_DNAm_meta_Cell9$Shore_mean_cat, levels = c(0,1), labels = c("Low", "High"))
table(HRS_DNAm_meta_Cell9$Shore_mean_cat)


  ## Factor Parent education (Parent_Education) variable
HRS_DNAm_meta_Cell9$Parent_Educ <- factor(HRS_DNAm_meta_Cell9$Parent_Education, levels = c(0,1), labels = c("High School & Beyond", "<High School"))
dfSummary(HRS_DNAm_meta_Cell9$Parent_Educ)
dfSummary(HRS_DNAm_meta_Cell9$Parent_Education)


  ## Create reverse code of SCHLYRS variable
summary(HRS_DNAm_meta_Cell9$SCHLYRS)
HRS_DNAm_meta_Cell9 <- as_tibble(HRS_DNAm_meta_Cell9)
HRS_DNAm_meta_Cell9 <- HRS_DNAm_meta_Cell9 %>% reverse_scale(SCHLYRS, 
                                                             name = "SCHLYRS_rev",
                                                             lower_end = 0,
                                                             upper_end = 17) 

```

## CHECK RESPONSE AND SET REFERENCE LEVELS

```{r}

## Filter dataset to remove NA's from variables of interest
complete_7smk <- HRS_DNAm_meta_Cell9 %>% 
  filter(!(exclude == "TRUE")) %>%
  filter(!is.na(globalmethylation)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Island_mean)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(OpenSea_mean)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Shelf_mean)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Shore_mean)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(age)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(sex)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(race.ethnicity)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(childrural_democoggen)) %>% 
  filter(!is.na(SCHLYRS)) %>% 
  filter(!is.na(CHSMOKE_R)) %>% 
  filter(!is.na(LIVEGPAR_R)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(smoke_latest)) %>%  
  filter(!is.na(BEALE_latest)) %>% 
  filter(!is.na(HORVATH_DNAMAGE)) %>% 
  filter(!is.na(HANNUM_DNAMAGE)) %>% 
  filter(!is.na(LEVINE_DNAMAGE)) %>% 
  filter(!is.na(DNAMGRIMAGE)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(MPOA)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(GR)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(B)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(NK)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(CD4)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(CD8)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(MO)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(HIBP_latest)) %>% 
  filter(!is.na(DIAB_latest)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(VIGACT_collapsed)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(ATOTB_latest)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Parent_Educ)) %>% 
  mutate(included = 1)   #give variable called included a value of 1 if the above variables are not missing


## Check concordance of child smoking and adult smoking
table(complete_7smk$CHSMOKE, complete_7smk$smoke2016) #7 people reported childhood smoking but Never adult smoking (drop them)

  ## Define the HHIDPN numbers to drop (n=7)
complete_7smk %>% group_by(HHIDPN) %>% 
   filter(smoke_latest == "Never" & CHSMOKE_R == "Yes") %>%
   ungroup
hhidpn_to_mark_na <- c(526030020, 33566020, 177906010, 76697040, 60880010, 54616040, 54796010)  


## Create new logical flag column 'flag_for_exclusion' and set to TRUE for specified HHIDPNs
HRS_DNAm_meta_Cell9$flag_for_exclusion <- HRS_DNAm_meta_Cell9$HHIDPN %in% hhidpn_to_mark_na
dfSummary(HRS_DNAm_meta_Cell9$flag_for_exclusion)


## Setting reference levels for categorical variables 
HRS_DNAm_meta_Cell9$smoke_latest <- ordered(HRS_DNAm_meta_Cell9$smoke_latest, levels = c("Current", "Former", "Never"))
HRS_DNAm_meta_Cell9$HIBP_latest <- ordered(HRS_DNAm_meta_Cell9$HIBP_latest, levels = c("Yes", "No"))
HRS_DNAm_meta_Cell9$DIAB_latest <- ordered(HRS_DNAm_meta_Cell9$DIAB_latest, levels = c("Yes", "No"))
HRS_DNAm_meta_Cell9$VIGACT_collapsed <- ordered(HRS_DNAm_meta_Cell9$VIGACT_collapsed, levels = c("Every day/>1 per week", "1 per week/1-3 per month", "Never"))
HRS_DNAm_meta_Cell9$CHSMOKE_R <- ordered(HRS_DNAm_meta_Cell9$CHSMOKE_R, levels = c("Yes", "No"))
HRS_DNAm_meta_Cell9$childrural_democoggen <- ordered(HRS_DNAm_meta_Cell9$childrural_democoggen, levels = c("Yes", "No"))
HRS_DNAm_meta_Cell9$LIVEGPAR_R <- ordered(HRS_DNAm_meta_Cell9$LIVEGPAR_R, levels = c("Yes", "No"))


rm(complete_7smk, hhidpn_to_mark_na)

```

#CREATE DNAM AGE ACCELERATION VARIABLES AMONG ENTIRE HRS METHYLATION SAMPLE (4,018)

```{r}

#Get outcome variable: Residuals & Acceleration
  ##Code from: https://github.com/bakulskilab/Depressive-DNAm-Acceleration/blob/main/01_Data_management_HW.R
  ##Age acceleration based on GrimAge
HRS_DNAm_meta_Cell9$GRIM_residuals <- residuals(lm(DNAMGRIMAGE ~ age, data = HRS_DNAm_meta_Cell9, na.action = na.exclude))
summary(HRS_DNAm_meta_Cell9$GRIM_residuals)

HRS_DNAm_meta_Cell9 <- HRS_DNAm_meta_Cell9 %>% mutate(GRIMAccel = ifelse((GRIM_residuals > 0), 1, 0))
HRS_DNAm_meta_Cell9$GRIMAccel <- factor(HRS_DNAm_meta_Cell9$GRIMAccel, levels = c(0,1), labels = c("Age not accelerated", "Age accelerated"))
table(HRS_DNAm_meta_Cell9$GRIMAccel)


  ## Age acceleration based on HORVATH
HRS_DNAm_meta_Cell9$HORVATH_residuals <- residuals(lm(HORVATH_DNAMAGE ~ age, data = HRS_DNAm_meta_Cell9, na.action = na.exclude))
summary(HRS_DNAm_meta_Cell9$HORVATH_residuals)

HRS_DNAm_meta_Cell9 <- HRS_DNAm_meta_Cell9 %>% mutate(HORVATHAccel = ifelse((HORVATH_residuals > 0), 1, 0))
HRS_DNAm_meta_Cell9$HORVATHAccel <- factor(HRS_DNAm_meta_Cell9$HORVATHAccel, levels = c(0,1), labels =  c("Age not accelerated", "Age accelerated"))
table(HRS_DNAm_meta_Cell9$HORVATHAccel)


  ## Age acceleration based on LEVINE
HRS_DNAm_meta_Cell9$LEVINE_residuals <- residuals(lm(LEVINE_DNAMAGE ~ age, data = HRS_DNAm_meta_Cell9, na.action = na.exclude))
summary(HRS_DNAm_meta_Cell9$LEVINE_residuals)

HRS_DNAm_meta_Cell9 <- HRS_DNAm_meta_Cell9 %>% mutate(LEVINEAccel = ifelse((LEVINE_residuals > 0), 1, 0))
HRS_DNAm_meta_Cell9$LEVINEAccel <- factor(HRS_DNAm_meta_Cell9$LEVINEAccel, levels = c(0,1), labels = c("Age not accelerated", "Age accelerated"))
table(HRS_DNAm_meta_Cell9$LEVINEAccel)


  ## Age acceleration based on MPOA (transform prior to accel)
HRS_DNAm_meta_Cell9$MPOA_residuals <- residuals(lm(MPOA*age ~ age, data = HRS_DNAm_meta_Cell9, na.action = na.exclude))
summary(HRS_DNAm_meta_Cell9$MPOA_residuals)

HRS_DNAm_meta_Cell9 <- HRS_DNAm_meta_Cell9 %>% mutate(MPOAAccel = ifelse((MPOA_residuals > 0), 1, 0))
HRS_DNAm_meta_Cell9$MPOAAccel <- factor(HRS_DNAm_meta_Cell9$MPOAAccel, levels = c(0,1), labels = c("Age not accelerated", "Age accelerated"))
table(HRS_DNAm_meta_Cell9$MPOAAccel)


  ## Age acceleration based on HANNUM
HRS_DNAm_meta_Cell9$HANNUM_residuals <- residuals(lm(HANNUM_DNAMAGE ~ age, data = HRS_DNAm_meta_Cell9, na.action = na.exclude))
summary(HRS_DNAm_meta_Cell9$HANNUM_residuals)

HRS_DNAm_meta_Cell9 <- HRS_DNAm_meta_Cell9 %>% mutate(HANNUMAccel = ifelse((HANNUM_residuals > 0), 1, 0))
HRS_DNAm_meta_Cell9$HANNUMAccel <- factor(HRS_DNAm_meta_Cell9$HANNUMAccel, levels = c(0,1), labels =  c("Age not accelerated", "Age accelerated"))
table(HRS_DNAm_meta_Cell9$HANNUMAccel)

```
